instructions: Continue from the exact failed candidate c3d822c147e52bb85f2786d03f113fc78b8f8e67 produced by RUN-121-003; preserve the existing candidate and do not restart TASK-121 revision 2 from its canonical base.

Treat RUN-121-003 as an execution interruption caused by the Antigravity provider returning 503 UNAVAILABLE after the candidate commit already existed; this is not a semantic rejection of the candidate.

Complete only the remaining implementation and result-package work required by TASK-121 revision 2. A zero additional code delta is acceptable if the failed candidate already satisfies the TASK; otherwise mutate only the authorized modification_scope.

acceptance.condition: A versioned AIOS_BRAIN_SYNC_SNAPSHOT can deterministically reconstruct repository/main identity, roadmap planning status, selected exact TASK identity when uniquely justified, existing Unified State lifecycle next_action/authority, and explicit blockers from a canonical repository without using chat/model memory.

Snapshot selection fails closed for missing, ambiguous, unauthored, or contradictory planning/lineage state and never fabricates completion, TASK/RUN identity, Human priority, Executor choice, transport success, review verdict, or publication outcome.

Snapshot generation is observably read-only and does not create RUNs, invoke Executors, run verification, mutate worktree/refs/roadmap, dispatch carriers, or publish; existing Unified State is reused rather than reimplemented.

The durable Project Contract defines cross-context rehydration ordering and authority guards for AUTHOR_TASK-before-PRIMARY, addressed versus non-target carrier receipts, dispatch acceptance versus terminal engineering state, automatic PASS publication continuation, admission failure versus RUN failure, evidence reuse, and prohibition of mutation-only capability probes.

Interruption/resume guidance preserves Human/Brain roadmap authority: explicit current Human override may redirect work, but future generic continuation relies only on a canonicalized bookmark reconciled with exact lineage; Runtime/snapshot never advances or chooses roadmap semantics autonomously.

Existing Kernel, Unified State, Human Surface, Runtime, Executor, Reviewer, correction, transport, publication, and downstream pin semantics remain behaviorally unchanged; all implementation mutation stays inside the three authorized files.
Focused deterministic regression verification passes for the new snapshot and existing Unified State compatibility, with zero unresolved items and no network/model dependency.

assumptions: Canonical AIOS-renew main at authoring is 3cbea35eaff59598b2e5af76aba3cb0fd7f1cbc3, the reviewed and published TASK-120 candidate.

TASK-120 revision 1 is complete: RUN-120-001 produced the exact candidate above, REVIEW-120-001 is PRIMARY PASS, Brain Ingress canonicalized the PASS decision, and safe publication advanced main to that reviewed source.
Frozen Kernel v0.1 remains FROZEN. Brain owns roadmap architecture and semantic judgment; Runtime remains deterministic coordination software and must not become a Planner or Reviewer.

.ai/roadmap-state.yaml is Human/Brain planning state subordinate to canonical engineering lineage. Existing Unified State remains authoritative for deterministic lifecycle reduction of an exact TASK revision and must not be duplicated semantically.
GitHub Issues, workflow receipts, refs, and transport artifacts are subordinate delivery mechanisms. Dispatch acceptance is not RUN, RESULT, review, or publication success.

hard: Provide one versioned deterministic AIOS_BRAIN_SYNC_SNAPSHOT read-only surface whose output is derived only from the repository's canonical local/remote Git facts already available to AIOS, .ai/roadmap-state.yaml when present, canonical TASK identity, and existing Unified State reduction for the selected exact TASK revision. Do not duplicate lifecycle inference already owned by Unified State.

The snapshot must establish repository/main identity and planning bookmark before presenting continuation facts. It must distinguish planning state from engineering truth and expose conflicts/blockers rather than silently choosing through them.

For a generic continuation with one canonical roadmap NEXT, the snapshot may identify that exact TASK/bookmark and report the existing Unified State next_action and authority; it must not invent a NEXT item, choose among ambiguous priorities, or convert planning intent into completion evidence.

Completed tracks with zero NEXT items, missing roadmap state, ambiguous/multiple NEXT items, a NEXT task that is not canonically authored, and roadmap/lineage contradictions must be represented explicitly and fail closed for automatic continuation selection.

Snapshot generation is observation only: run_created=false, executor_invoked=false, verification_invoked=false, state_mutated=false. It must not create RUNs, invoke an Executor, execute verification, author TASK/review/correction artifacts, dispatch carriers, publish, mutate refs/worktree, or update roadmap state.

The snapshot must not claim transport or automation completion that cannot be proven from canonical engineering state. Durable Project Contract guidance must require Brain to interpret addressed carrier receipts by family, ignore non-target REJECTED fan-out as lifecycle truth, distinguish dispatch acceptance from execution outcome, and inspect canonical terminal/review/publication state before acting again.

Durable Brain Sync guidance must encode ordering guards demonstrated by history: confirm AUTHOR_TASK canonicalization before PRIMARY dispatch; after semantic PASS use the canonical publication-continuation surface and observe publication outcome before manual fallback; never convert admission failure into RUN repair; never rerun unchanged verification for ceremony; never perform canonical mutation solely as a capability probe.

Interruption/side-track semantics must remain Brain planning semantics: explicit current Human priority outranks an older bookmark prospectively, but later generic continuation may rely on that priority only after it is canonicalized. Returning from a bounded side-track must be resolved from current canonical bookmark plus lineage, not chat memory.

Output must be compact, stable, deterministic, JSON-serializable, and contain enough provenance to explain the selected or blocked continuation without embedding chat history, raw logs, secrets, credentials, or unbounded repository data.

Existing Unified State, Human Surface, operator execution, Runtime verification, review, correction, publication, and frozen Kernel behavior must remain unchanged. The new module may compose their read-only facts but cannot acquire their mutation or semantic authority.

Deterministic offline tests must cover ready single-NEXT rehydration, completed/no-NEXT, missing roadmap, ambiguous NEXT, unauthored NEXT, roadmap/lifecycle conflict, and proof that observation performs no RUN/Executor/verification/state mutation. Tests must not depend on GitHub/network, wall clock, model/provider, chat state, or mutable external services.

task.goal: Harden cross-context Brain continuity by providing one deterministic, read-only canonical rehydration snapshot that a fresh Brain can use before roadmap/task/review/repair/publication reasoning to recover repository identity, planning bookmark, exact lifecycle state, next authority, and bounded control-plane continuation facts without relying on chat memory or turning Runtime into a Planner. Align the durable Brain Sync contract with that snapshot so interruption/resume, side-track return, transport receipts, and automatic continuation are interpreted from canonical state rather than remembered procedure.
non_goals: Add a Planner agent, Reviewer agent, memory database, conversation store, daemon, watcher, polling loop, broker, scheduler, autonomous retry/reroute, or generic lifecycle router.
Move roadmap architecture, Human priority, semantic review, TASK authoring, Executor choice, publication judgment, or correction judgment into Runtime or deterministic software.
Mutate .ai/roadmap-state.yaml automatically after execution, review, publication, transport, or sync observation; roadmap advancement remains Human/Brain planning authority.

Replace or reinterpret Unified State lifecycle reduction, Human Surface execution behavior, TASK-108 PRIMARY, TASK-110 publication continuation, TASK-111 REPAIR, TASK-112 REMEDIATION, TASK-113 ATTENTION, Brain Ingress, Reviewer, Publisher, or Executor authority.
Query ChatGPT history, model memory, screenshots, GitHub UI labels, network services, Issues, Actions, or mutable external state from the deterministic snapshot implementation.
Treat carrier acceptance/rejection as engineering completion truth or make non-target carrier noise part of TASK lifecycle truth.
Probe GitHub/repository write capability by creating, modifying, or deleting product/source files, branches, commits, refs, Issues, or other canonical mutations.
Change downstream repositories or pins, or assume a downstream repository uses current AIOS-renew main.
Push or publish from Executor implementation execution.
task.problem: Repeated production history shows one causal family at the Brain boundary despite existing canonical facts: continuation required TASK-092 executor-instruction hardening and TASK-102 stale-local synchronization hardening; later fresh Brain contexts forgot the canonical TASK-108 wakeup carrier, nearly substituted manual publication for TASK-110 automatic continuation, treated non-target carrier REJECTED comments as meaningful noise, and during TASK-120 authoring dispatched PRIMARY before AUTHOR_TASK canonicalization was confirmed. Separate capability probing also mutated canonical main merely to discover write behavior. The current Project Contract describes BRAIN SYNC, roadmap-state records planning state, and Unified State deterministically reduces one TASK lifecycle, but a fresh Brain must still manually compose these surfaces and remember their ordering/authority semantics. That composition gap permits the same class of context-loss error to recur.
